I was impressed. The doctor was kind and had a very gentle touch. I was a bit hesitant, but in reality, it didn't hurt at all. It hurt much less than an injection. In short, after I had the acupuncture, my stomach pain was much lighter. My period came the next morning. Another thing is that the doctor gave very good advice about taking care of myself and adjusting my diet, so much so that I had to write this review. I'm now starting to look into additional back pain treatment programs. I'll go see the doctor again when I have the chance.
